text:
Tokyo has five Christmas markets this December.
Two are free to walk into 👇

🎯 Guess which ones, then check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/tokyo-christmas-markets-2026

🎄 Roppongi Hills: free, about ten stalls.
21 Nov–25 Dec, 11:00–21:00.

🎄 Skytree Town: no ticket listed.
Fifteen huts, drinks in boot-shaped mugs.

🎄 Shin-Toyosu: by the water, from 20 Nov.
¥1,000 weekdays, ¥1,500 weekends.

🎄 Shiba Park: from 4 Dec, open to 22:00.
Same prices as Shin-Toyosu.

🎄 Yokohama Red Brick: an 11 m tree,
entry from ¥500.

📅 On 24–25 Dec the Tokyo Christmas Market
costs ¥2,000 per adult.

👉 The two mugs that stack into a pyramid:
https://japanbystation.com/tokyo-christmas-markets-2026

Which one would you pick? 🎄
